# ECN-2026-012 Change notice - Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01

Reason for change
- Current process control for the induction billet heater has produced variability in downstream ring rolling metallurgy and surface finish. This ECN standardizes the target billet temperature for EQ-P2-L2-IH01 to improve metallurgical consistency and reduce rework rates.
- The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C. This value will be used as the setpoint for process control and operator checks.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01 (induction billet heater #1)
- Procedures: SOP-P2-L2-04 will be revised to reflect the new target setpoint and operator verification steps.
- Maintenance and calibration: MM-P2-L2-IH01 will be updated to include verification of sensors and control elements related to the new setpoint.
- Quality: QS-PROC-07 will be referenced for acceptance criteria; quality hold and release steps will align to the new target temperature.

Implementation
- Control update: Control system setpoint and alarm parameters for EQ-P2-L2-IH01 will be configured to target 1230 °C as the nominal billet temperature. Operator displays and batch logs will show the target value.
- Procedure changes: Revise SOP-P2-L2-04 to include explicit checks for the target billet temperature of 1230 °C during heat-up, soak, and transfer stages. Update operator sign-off fields to include confirmation of this target.
- Maintenance tasks: Update MM-P2-L2-IH01 to require verification of temperature sensors and control feedback used to achieve 1230 °C. Record all verifications per maintenance documentation.
- Quality alignment: QS-PROC-07 will be consulted for acceptance sampling and documentation requirements tied to the target billet temperature of 1230 °C.
- Training: Operators and maintenance personnel will receive brief training on the setpoint change and revised SOP-P2-L2-04 content prior to go-live.

Approvals
- Engineering approval required for control configuration change.
- Maintenance approval required for updates to MM-P2-L2-IH01.
- Quality approval required to confirm alignment with QS-PROC-07.

Related documents: MM-P2-L2-IH01, QS-PROC-07, SOP-P2-L2-04
